data.name: Tabernacle
data.detailed_description:
Tabernacle is a 1-4 player cooperative survival horror game developed by Dongo Wongo Games.

Take on the role of an Inquisitor sent to investigate once holy places that have been corrupted by sin.

Perform your duties and gather evidence of wickedness, solve hexing puzzles, and reclaim the sacred sites.
Though, do so carefully, as the evil entities within have sensed your arrival.

SURVIVE ALONE OR TOGETHER

Explore the sites alone or venture forth alongside up to three other players.

All tasks can be performed alone, though survival relies on balance between resources, speed, safety, and stealth.
Will you choose to shoulder the burden as one, or share the weight with those of the same oath?

Survival means working together

PERFORM YOUR DUTIES AND ESCAPE

Every location contains a series of objectives that are your mission to complete.
Search for evidence, hexed objects, keys, and other resources hidden throughout the environment.
Perform cleansing rituals, solve puzzles to uncover secrets, and dispel the evil that has overcome these sites.

Once completed, your final task will be to escape with your life.

Explore and search for key items to progress

FACE DISTINCT MONSTERS

Survival primarily depends on hiding or escaping.
Utilize the environment or find items in the level to disable or distract the monster, buying a window to break away.
Monsters have unique abilities and behaviors, identify these and strategize around them to survive.

Whether alone or in a group, monsters always pose a threat to you

data.short_description: Tabernacle is a 1-4 player online co-op horror game. Once holy places have been forsaken and corrupted by sin. Do your duties as inquisitors of the church; collect evidence of evil, reclaim sacred sites, and banish the unholy that seek to extinguish faith. Stand between the innocent and the damned.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400/AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 8 GB/AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT 6 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Still gathering performance information, these are estimates based on limited testing of a small pool.

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-13600K/AMD Ryzen 7 5800XT 8-Core Processor

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains horror themes, depictions of violence, blood, gore, frightening creatures, and scenes of character death. Players may encounter disturbing imagery, intense chase sequences, and graphic monster attacks. No sexual content or explicit nudity is present.
